about: Explainer, part 1: a request's journey. Narrated; the pipeline animation cuts to these lines.

lines.text: When someone talks to your add-on, their words take a trip.
lines.direction: Warm, confident tech-launch narrator. Brisk and upbeat, a hint of intrigue on 'take a trip'.

lines.text: Speech recognition turns the sound into text. And sometimes, fifteen becomes fifty.
lines.direction: Brisk narrator; a small knowing smile on 'fifteen becomes fifty'.

lines.text: The assistant's model picks one of your tools, and fills in the numbers.
Your add-on answers. Out loud. Every word of it.
lines.direction: Short punchy beats, a slight pause between the three phrases.

lines.text: Hearsay rides along the whole trip, and asks four questions a listener would ask.
lines.direction: Confident reveal, a lift in energy on 'Hearsay'. Brisk.
